ponytail.name: Ponytail
ponytail.description: The most effort ponytail will ever ask of you — Claude Code and Codex plugins run two tiny Node.js lifecycle hooks, so node needs to be on your PATH (note for Nix/nvm users: it must be on the non-interactive shell's PATH). If it isn't, the skills still work, the always-on activation just stays quiet instead of erroring on every prompt.
